parameters.name: MFABindRequired
parameters.description: Specifies whether a multi-factor authentication (MFA) device must be bound to the RAM user upon logon.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The logon password of the RAM user. The password must meet the password strength requirements.

parameters.name: PasswordResetRequired
parameters.description: Specifies whether the RAM user has to change the password upon logon.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram update-login-profile --user-name zhangq0000 --password mypassword --password-reset-required true --mfa-bind-required true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ram UpdateLoginProfile --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordResetRequired true --UserName zhangq0000 --MFABindRequired true --Password mypassword
